releaseNotes: Reintegrated Claude dashboard with Today/Week/Month/Year/Books/Habits tabs, 14 achievement tracks, adjustable reminders/yearly books goal, Anki deck picker/undo/session summary, and sharper vector PDF zoom through 300%. Fixes dashboard memory growth, PDF zoom attempt persistence, Anki grade order on exit and review-counter locking. Anki controls: Confirm Good, hold Confirm Easy, Left Again, Right Hard; Back never grades. English-only UI/hyphenation; Nearby reader-to-reader features omitted. Original-X4 production build, 84 host tests and simulator smoke passed. Test candidate: physical boot/UI and live Anki/OTA acceptance pending. Keep SD backups before testing or downgrade.
